records.name: ULTIMUNE with LISA | 資生堂
records.hero_grammar: Celebrity/identity-led editorial hero; aspiration precedes product detail.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Large portrait/editorial media with generous negative space; product imagery enters after identity story.
records.typography_hierarchy: Oversized campaign display type hands off to restrained product/info hierarchy.
records.color_topology: High-contrast branded campaign palette; color acts as narrative accent, not mere skin.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Low-density opening, then dense event/product utility, creating deliberate aspiration→transaction rhythm.
records.module_composition_grammar: identity manifesto → collaboration → kit/product → event/availability → purchase
records.cta_choreography: Purchase is delayed until desire/context is established, then repeated around concrete kit availability.
records.trust_proof_placement: Product composition, prices, availability and event constraints provide late-page operational proof.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile must preserve portrait impact and campaign sequencing without collapsing identity story into a generic stack.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Ambassador narrative is structurally integrated with commerce/event logistics.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: distinctive identity-to-commerce topology; not explained by color/photo swap.

records.name: KUKUILASH ククイラッシュ｜mandom
records.hero_grammar: Single-product promise hero immediately states result territory and ingredient/technology basis.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Product pack + eye-area imagery; close-up explanatory images carry mechanism and usage.
records.typography_hierarchy: Compact benefit headline, numbered proof points, then instructional hierarchy.
records.color_topology: Clean light base with natural/technical accents; low decorative competition.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Moderate density with proof peaks around ingredients, free-from claims and how-to.
records.module_composition_grammar: problem recognition → four commitments → safety/free-from → ingredient provenance → usage → buy
records.cta_choreography: Buy Now appears early and again after evidence/usage; purchase is contextual rather than omnipresent.
records.trust_proof_placement: Ingredient functions, free-from list, application method and caveats are distributed through the page.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve numbered proof and usage steps as legible sequences rather than equal cards.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Combines natural-origin provenance with technical hair-science proof in one causal story.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING: product-LP grammar is familiar, but proof topology is specific to eyelash risk/use.

records.name: FAIRLUCENT メナード化粧品｜ブライトニング
records.hero_grammar: Starts with category confusion ('what do I need?') rather than product glamour.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Product and muse imagery are secondary to guided explanation and diagnostic choice.
records.typography_hierarchy: Question-led headings and clinically precise subheads create progressive comprehension.
records.color_topology: Bright clean base; product distinctions and diagnostic states carry controlled accents.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Alternates explanation blocks with product lineup and interactive decision density.
records.module_composition_grammar: confusion framing → ingredient authority → lineup → use-order → diagnostic selector → recommendation
records.cta_choreography: CTA is routed through diagnosis/lineup rather than one undifferentiated buy button.
records.trust_proof_placement: APM history, efficacy boundaries, SPF/ISO notes, user sample provenance and use-order sit near decisions.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: On mobile the diagnostic sequence should become a stepwise interaction, not a four-column reduction.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: A real selector converts abstract 'brightening' ambiguity into an item recommendation.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: decision architecture is hard to skin-swap without changing the customer problem.

records.name: 大島椿 創業100周年サイト
records.hero_grammar: Anniversary heritage hero makes longevity/provenance the primary authority.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Archival/product/history media supports continuity; historical moments act as visual chapters.
records.typography_hierarchy: Editorial commemorative hierarchy with date/era emphasis.
records.color_topology: Heritage-led restrained brand palette; color supports continuity rather than novelty.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Slow chapter rhythm with history/provenance beats and commemorative emphasis.
records.module_composition_grammar: heritage opening → century story → people/product continuity → present commitment
records.cta_choreography: Commercial action is subordinate to brand/provenance understanding.
records.trust_proof_placement: 100-year chronology and accumulated brand history operate as proof rather than testimonial volume.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve chronology as authored chapters with clear era transitions.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Time itself is used as composition and trust grammar.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: provenance topology cannot be replicated by swapping products into a generic launch page.

records.name: Inside Out Beauty
records.hero_grammar: Concept-led hero frames beauty as an inside/out relationship before products.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Lifestyle/body/skin imagery works as conceptual evidence rather than catalog illustration.
records.typography_hierarchy: Editorial explanatory hierarchy; concept language transitions into practical content.
records.color_topology: Soft wellness palette with restrained contrast.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Low-to-medium density; reflective opening expands into educational content.
records.module_composition_grammar: concept → self-understanding → body/skin relationship → practical content/next exploration
records.cta_choreography: Low-commitment exploration precedes commerce; CTA supports learning.
records.trust_proof_placement: Authority comes from FANCL context plus explanatory linkage, not aggressive claim stacking.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve editorial pacing and avoid compressing concept paragraphs into dense product blocks.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Wellness education is the conversion precondition, not a decorative brand story.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING: content topology follows category education rather than standard SKU order.

records.name: BOTANIST | ROOTH（ルース）
records.hero_grammar: Botanical/sensory hero establishes a scalp-care world before specifications.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Plant/product textures and environmental media create tactile anticipation.
records.typography_hierarchy: Elegant display hierarchy with measured product-detail handoff.
records.color_topology: Botanical/natural tones used in fields rather than isolated accents.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Slow immersive rhythm punctuated by denser ingredient/product sections.
records.module_composition_grammar: sensory world → concern framing → botanical mechanism → product/use → purchase
records.cta_choreography: Commerce appears after sensory and mechanism context, with repeated product-level action.
records.trust_proof_placement: Ingredient/mechanism detail grounds the atmospheric opening.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should turn wide botanical compositions into intentional crops, preserving texture and focal hierarchy.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Atmosphere and care mechanism are linked instead of living in separate hero/product sections.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM-LEANING: sensory grammar has product-specific material logic.

records.name: 栄養モニタリングサービス Vivoo | 大塚製薬
records.hero_grammar: Service hero frames monitoring as an actionable self-knowledge loop.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Device/result/app imagery explains the workflow rather than decorating it.
records.typography_hierarchy: Utility-first hierarchy with clear steps and result interpretation.
records.color_topology: Clean health-tech palette with controlled diagnostic accents.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Medium density; method and result interpretation form the main proof peaks.
records.cta_choreography: CTA is tied to starting the monitoring flow, not generic contact.
records.trust_proof_placement: Method explanation and service workflow reduce uncertainty about what happens after purchase.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should preserve the measure/result loop as a short sequential story.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: The page visualizes a next-event loop rather than a static feature list.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: workflow topology is service-specific and not reducible to cosmetic skinning.

records.name: EMSリフトブラシ 3Dケア | SALONIA(サロニア)
records.hero_grammar: High-impact product hero states premium device promise and immediately anchors price/technology.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Product/model media is interleaved with diagrams, comparison, before/after and use imagery.
records.typography_hierarchy: Large performance claims transition into precise numbered technical sections.
records.color_topology: High-contrast tech-beauty palette; proof diagrams carry functional color.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: High proof density with deliberate breathing spaces around major performance claims.
records.module_composition_grammar: promise → technology → quantified proof → features → how-to → product comparison → purchase
records.cta_choreography: Purchase available early; later CTAs follow proof, usage and lineup comparison.
records.trust_proof_placement: Quantified self-test conditions, waterproof standard, caveats, usage limits and comparison specs are embedded locally.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile must re-author complex comparisons/diagrams and not simply shrink the desktop proof wall.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Proof, legal caveats, use boundaries and commerce are choreographed as one authority system.
records.template_like_vs_custom_signals: CUSTOM: technology-specific proof topology strongly differentiates screenshot gestalt.

records.name: 男を輝かせるBarber | DAN BRISE
records.hero_grammar: Barber identity hero frames grooming as a masculine experience/relationship rather than menu-first.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: People, craft and space imagery establish place-specific authority.
records.typography_hierarchy: Bold identity type paired with service-level utility hierarchy.
records.color_topology: Dark/neutral grooming palette with high-contrast identity moments.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Atmospheric opening, then practical service/booking density.
records.module_composition_grammar: identity/place → barber craft → service/menu → people/access → booking
records.cta_choreography: Booking follows establishment of place and barber character.
records.trust_proof_placement: Real space, staff/service specificity and local access form the trust layer.
records.desktop_to_mobile_transformation: Mobile should prioritize face/place crops and keep booking reachable without turning every section into CTA chrome.
records.distinctive_authored_mechanisms: Local service brand behaves like an authored editorial place, not a salon template.

records.name: doodle 赤ちゃんと通える産後骨盤矯正･ダイエット専門院
records.hero_grammar: Need-state hero addresses postpartum/body concerns and visit feasibility.
records.media_strategy_crop_negative_space: Human/service-context imagery supports reassurance; practical care information carries more weight than glamour.
records.typography_hierarchy: Warm approachable headings with clear treatment/service utility text.
records.color_topology: Soft local-care palette; trust content avoids clinical harshness.
records.density_whitespace_rhythm: Alternates empathetic recognition with practical process and access information.
records.module_composition_grammar: recognition → why this service → care/process → visit-with-baby reassurance → booking/access
records.cta_choreography: Booking is earned through objection removal around care and visit logistics.
